ENVIRONMENTAL ACTIVITIES — PREMIUM REVISION PAPER #3
====

GRADE: Grade 1
SUBJECT: ENVIRONMENTAL ACTIVITIES
TIME ALLOWED: 2 hours 30 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 100
EXAM BODY: KPSEA

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Which change is a physical change? (1 mark)
   A. Paper burning to ash
   B. Ice melting to water
   C. Iron rusting
   D. Milk souring

2. Photosynthesis mainly produces: (1 mark)
   A. Glucose and oxygen
   B. Only water vapour
   C. Only carbon dioxide
   D. Nitrogen gas only

3. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Sounds that alert us? (1 mark)
   A. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Sounds that alert us.
   B. Guess results without recording observations on Sounds that alert us.
   C. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Sounds that alert us.
   D. Skip labelling diagrams related to Sounds that alert us.

4. Diffusion is best described as: (1 mark)
   A. Heating until a solid melts
   B. Net movement of particles from high to low concentration
   C. A chemical reaction forming ash
   D. Movement of water only across a membrane

5. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Weather and Sky its resources? (1 mark)
   A. Skip labelling diagrams related to Weather and Sky its resources.
   B. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Weather and Sky its resources.
   C. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Weather and Sky its resources.
   D. Guess results without recording observations on Weather and Sky its resources.

6. Why is water unsuitable for a petrol fire? (1 mark)
   A. Petrol fires have no fuel
   B. Water can spread burning petrol instead of putting it out safely
   C. Water removes heat too quickly
   D. Water always increases oxygen

7. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Animals resources? (1 mark)
   A. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Animals resources.
   B. Guess results without recording observations on Animals resources.
   C. Skip labelling diagrams related to Animals resources.
   D. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Animals resources.

8. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Caring for c) develop positive attitude towards things found in the home (cleani? (1 mark)
   A. Skip labelling diagrams related to Caring for c) develop positive attitude towards things found in the home (cleani.
   B. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Caring for c) develop positive attitude towards things found in the home (cleani.
   C. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Caring for c) develop positive attitude towards things found in the home (cleani.
   D. Guess results without recording observations on Caring for c) develop positive attitude towards things found in the home (cleani.

9. A compound differs from a mixture because: (1 mark)
   A. A mixture always has a fixed melting point
   B. Elements in a compound are chemically combined in a fixed ratio
   C. A compound can be separated by filtering only
   D. Mixtures cannot exist in Kenya

10. In a food chain, green plants are usually: (1 mark)
   A. Primary consumers only
   B. Producers
   C. Tertiary consumers
   D. Decomposers only

11. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Uses of water? (1 mark)
   A. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Uses of water.
   B. Guess results without recording observations on Uses of water.
   C. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Uses of water.
   D. Skip labelling diagrams related to Uses of water.

12. Soil erosion is reduced by: (1 mark)
   A. Burning crop residue every week
   B. Removing all vegetation
   C. Planting cover crops and terracing slopes
   D. Overgrazing continuously

13. Boiling point of pure water at standard pressure is about: (1 mark)
   A. 50 °C
   B. 100 °C
   C. 0 °C
   D. 37 °C

14. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Soil its resources? (1 mark)
   A. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Soil its resources.
   B. Guess results without recording observations on Soil its resources.
   C. Skip labelling diagrams related to Soil its resources.
   D. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Soil its resources.

15. The SI unit of force is the: (1 mark)
   A. newton (N)
   B. joule (J)
   C. watt (W)
   D. pascal (Pa)

16. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Water? (1 mark)
   A. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Water.
   B. Skip labelling diagrams related to Water.
   C. Guess results without recording observations on Water.
   D. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Water.

17. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Energy resources? (1 mark)
   A. Skip labelling diagrams related to Energy resources.
   B. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Energy resources.
   C. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Energy resources.
   D. Guess results without recording observations on Energy resources.

18. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Exploring weather? (1 mark)
   A. Guess results without recording observations on Exploring weather.
   B. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Exploring weather.
   C. Skip labelling diagrams related to Exploring weather.
   D. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Exploring weather.

19. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Plants its resources? (1 mark)
   A. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Plants its resources.
   B. Skip labelling diagrams related to Plants its resources.
   C. Guess results without recording observations on Plants its resources.
   D. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Plants its resources.

20. An element is: (1 mark)
   A. Any substance that conducts electricity
   B. A mixture of two liquids
   C. Any white crystal used in cooking
   D. A pure substance that cannot be broken down into a simpler substance by chemical means

21. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Keeping home? (1 mark)
   A. Skip labelling diagrams related to Keeping home.
   B. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Keeping home.
   C. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Keeping home.
   D. Guess results without recording observations on Keeping home.

22. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Harmful effects of? (1 mark)
   A. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Harmful effects of.
   B. Skip labelling diagrams related to Harmful effects of.
   C. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Harmful effects of.
   D. Guess results without recording observations on Harmful effects of.

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
23. In three clear sentences, explain Exploring weather and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

24. In three clear sentences, explain Water and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

25. In three clear sentences, explain Uses of water and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

26. In three clear sentences, explain Soil its resources and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

27. In three clear sentences, explain Plants its resources and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

28. In three clear sentences, explain Animals resources and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

29. In three clear sentences, explain Energy resources and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

30. In three clear sentences, explain Sounds that alert us and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

31. In three clear sentences, explain Harmful effects of and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

32. In three clear sentences, explain Caring for c) develop positive attitude towards things found in the home (cleani and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)
